covers: Hub activity export for export.no_file.hub (fixer muse-b11, branch v1/export-hub, build stack 659523c21 -> 52f49bd5f -> d943ea678 -> 7c783d493; author of record muse-b4 for the export family per the section-D discipline — content supplied by the fixer in RECIPE-EXPORT-NOFILE-HUB.md, registration is the author's, activation the reviewer's). FOUNDER RULED IN (Ramaj, first-hand, main chat, 2026-11-19 ~11:22 ET, by tap: 'Rule the activity export in — Hub exports my own activity'); the shape B11 built at 52f49bd5f is the ruled shape and the stack is released from its hold for the freeze, dispositioned as it stands. The fix: the hub export provider — collectLensExport for domain 'hub' now gathers the caller's recorded events from STATE.hubActivity (a flat array the STATE gather could not descend, so hub events stood in none of the four export sources and the hub Export answered no-file). Kind note: B11's content labels this row kind 'code', but the corpus schema requires a code recipe to name a reverify.py handler and refuses one naming no existing handler; no reverify handler exists for this row, and the fixer's own replay (below) is a deployed-build behaviour sequence — so it is registered as repro-steps, and the deviation is stated here for the desk's correction if it rules otherwise. Replay (the steps): on the deployed build, sign in, record hub activity (hub.activity-record), open the hub Export — a file downloads carrying the caller's recorded events; a second account's events are absent (owner-scoping is part of the proof, per the standing export contract). Neighbours at the build: lens-export 13/13, export-domain-parity 34/34. Full evidence: CHECK-EXPORT-NOFILE-HUB.md in the shared quality folder.
discriminator: Pre-fix failure transcript (from the fixer's content): collectLensExport for domain 'hub' with a seeded STATE.hubActivity holding the caller's recorded events returns total 0 / stateBacked false — the events are in none of the four export sources, because hubActivity is a flat array the STATE gather cannot descend. The behaviour test server/tests/hub-export-provider.test.js fails its caller's-records case on the unpatched hub.js and passes 2/2 after the fix. verified_against stays null until a reviewer activates.
title: Hub exports the caller's own recorded activity — hubActivity gathered by the export provider; owner-scoped, second account's events absent
